name: usage-band-for-claude
description: Shows model, effort, ultracode, context use, rate limits and their reset times above the prompt, and chimes when Claude finishes or needs you

showBand.title: Show usage band
showBand.description: Show the usage line above the prompt

soundOnDone.title: Sound when Claude finishes
soundOnDone.description: Play a chime when Claude ends a turn

soundOnInput.title: Sound when Claude needs input
soundOnInput.description: Play a chime when Claude asks a question or waits for a permission

chimeStyle.title: Chime style
chimeStyle.description: Which chimes to play: classic, soft, marimba, arcade, glass or pop, or random for a different style each time. Hear one with /chimes <style>.

soundMode.title: How to sound
soundMode.description: auto: a chime on this machine, or a terminal notification over SSH or when no player is found. chime: always play the sound file where Claude Code runs. bell: always notify through the terminal.
